title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2/Cheats
text:
To activate these cheats, you must pause the game, hold down  /  /  / , and enter the following string of codes below. If done correctly, the screen will shake. Some cheats will require you to retry the level again after inputting the cheat to make it work.

List of Cheats

Neversoft Skaters
To get these skaters, you must enter the Neversoft Skaters cheat while on the main menu instead of the pause screen. If done correctly, the main menu wheel should spin. After that, go to Create-A-Skater and enter any of the following names to get a Neversoft-created skater.
